name: Fuentelespino de Haro (Spain)
description: Vertically divided blue and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Fuentelespino de Haro (a fountain and a wall on red).
history: Municipal flag of Fuentelespino de Haro; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Fuentelespino de Haro arms — fountain and wall
